item.description:
### Added - **Cursor usage now reaches your iPhone and Apple Watch.** The Included and API bars that the Mac has been showing since 0.5.4 now appear in the usage section on the phone, and on the watch alongside Claude and Codex. Needs the matching companion update; an older phone simply won't show the row.
### Fixed - **A model bar sitting at 0% is now shown on the phone too.** The Mac started showing those in 0.5.5; the phone and watch were still hiding them, so they listed fewer bars than the Mac beside them.
